subject: Hunting data for dead recovery models - is this acceptable?

messages.author: 39971e2c19b8ec70
messages.subject: Hunting data for dead recovery models - is this acceptable?
parts:
Hello,

I noticed some studies use ring recoveries of birds killed by hunting in dead recovery models - i.e. they use it in these models as "observed death". That seems very incorrect to me, since it's a sample of birds whose life has been cut short, so it will bias (underestimate) the survival probabilities. I think much more correct would be to use the hunting data in the models as "alive recapture with removal".

So, my questions:
1) Is this approach widely used and generally accepted as "good enough"? 
2) Are there any studies already that question this approach?
3) Are there any studies which use the ring recoveries from hunting data as alive recaptures, as I suggested?

Thank you very much!

Tomas
